header: What a month costs your practice
lead: Take the figures from last month's practice statistics. The formula below then estimates your next invoice.
bodytext:
Monthly total = plan + (extra practitioners × band rate) + (extra addresses × €25) + (SMS × €0.08) + (letters × €0.95) + (GB above 20 × €0.90) + add-ons

Example: seven practitioners at two addresses, 400 SMS and 60 recall letters a month, 24 GB stored and online booking.

€89 plan + (2 × €18) + (1 × €25) + (400 × €0.08) + (60 × €0.95) + (4 × €0.90) + €19 = €261.60 net, or €313.92 including 20% VAT.

One-off charges such as migration, training and terminal setup are not included. They appear once, on the invoice for the month of the work.
note: These are the standard rates. If you have a written offer, its figures apply for its term instead.

inputs.title: Plan price
inputs.text: Einzel €39, Praxis €89, Verbund €169. One line per practice, every month.

inputs.title: Practitioners above the plan
inputs.text: Count the practitioner accounts on the first of the month, subtract those the plan includes, and read the band rate.

inputs.title: Extra treatment addresses
inputs.text: Per address beyond the first, counted on the first of the month.

inputs.title: SMS reminders
inputs.text: About one per appointment, if the patient asked for reminders. Last month's count is on your practice statistics page.

inputs.title: Printed recall letters
inputs.text: Only letters that are printed and posted. Recalls sent by email cost nothing.

inputs.title: Document storage above 20 GB
inputs.text: Per gigabyte, measured on the last day of the month. A practice scanning every prescription reaches 20 GB in about three years.

inputs.title: Add-ons
inputs.text: Add up all active extras: online booking, patient app, waiting-list automation and second data location.
